title: DevPackagesConfig
description: Configuration for development repositories staged into `dev-packages/staging/` for `file:` consumption by this repo. The DevRepo and DevPackage types in stage-dev-packages.ts mirror this schema — if you change one, update the other.

repos.description: List of development repositories whose packages are staged into this repo.

DevRepo.description: A development repository containing one or more packages consumed by this repo.

folder.description: The directory name of the repo, used as both the clone destination under dev-packages/ and the sibling-directory fallback name.

cloneUrl.description: The git clone URL for the repo, used when the repo is not already present locally.

revision.description: The git revision (branch name, tag, or commit hash) to check out before building.

devPackages.description: The packages within this repo to build and stage.

DevPackage.description: A package within a dev repo that gets staged for `file:` consumption by this repo.

nxProject.description: The nx project name, used to build the package and roll up its type declarations.

packagePath.description: The package's path within its repo, e.g. `packages/platform`.

stagingFolder.description: The folder name under `dev-packages/staging/` to stage into. The `file:` specifiers in this repo's `package.json` files point at this name, so changing it means changing them too.
